Because the container is BestEffort with no requests or limits, set explicit requests and limits on the nginx container: as an advisory starting point for an nginx gateway, requests cpu 50m-100m and memory 64Mi-128Mi, with a memory limit around 2x the request and a CPU limit only if throttling is acceptable. Add a readinessProbe and livenessProbe on port 80 (the logs show a /health path being served) so the kubelet can detect a wedged nginx, and pin the image to a specific digest instead of the mutable nginx:latest tag so a restart pulls a known version.

If the gateway is meant to receive traffic from inside or outside the cluster, create a Service in app-102a selecting app=nginx (targetPort 80), since no Service currently exists there; otherwise document that the pod is deliberately cluster-internal only.
